newsitem.title: UK: New sugar freight business cited but fixtures few.
newsitem.headline: New sugar freight business cited but fixtures few.

text.p: London's sugar freight market saw only a handful of new enquiries on Wednesday from mixed origins and only one fixture was reported, shipbrokers said.
Booker quoted for 7,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from St Kitts to Nantes for July 7/12, while Jean Lion was open for 14,000 tonnes in bags from Santos to Algeria for July shipment dates.

CSR entered the market with a new bulk order for 40,000 tonnes from Queensland to Adabiya for July 15/20 and was said to be closely working its enquiry for 30,000 tonnes to the Black Sea, issued on Tuesday.
Cargill quoted for 12,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Corinto to Black Sea/Baltic/Egyptian Med for spot and Genoc was open for 12,000 tonnes from Thailand to Indonesia for July 3/10.
Shipbrokers said the only firmer business of the day came from Tate & Lyle, which fixed 12,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Belize to London/Greenock for July 7/12.
